lines.text: Leo checked out a spectacular book about roaring dinosaurs from the library!
I promise to keep it dry, clean, and return it on Friday! Leo told Librarian Owl.
On Thursday afternoon, he tossed the book into the wet grass while chasing a soccer ball!
Dark storm clouds rolled in, and raindrops began splashing onto the colorful pages!
Leo remembered his promise, dove across the lawn, and shielded the book with his coat!
He dried the cover with a soft towel, placed it safely in his backpack, and returned it on time!
Librarian Owl stamped his card with a gold star and said, You are someone we can trust!
Keeping your promises is like building an invisible bridge of trust that never breaks!
